description: File path portability check across Windows, macOS and Linux — Checks up to 500 relative file paths for names that break or collide on Windows, macOS or Linux: Windows reserved device names (CON.txt, NUL.tar.gz, COM¹), reserved characters, trailing dots and spaces, component and total length limits, and distinct paths that become one file through case folding or NFC/NFD normalization. For an agent that writes files from an archive, a generated tree or a repo

destinationRoot.description: Directory the paths will be created under; counted towards the total path length.

paths.description: Relative paths with "/" separators. At most 200000 characters in total.

name: path-portability
